The seven posts mentioning @BarackObama span several unrelated topics:

- A question challenging why he would "wire Trump tower" but not release his tax returns [T4-006979](#T4-006979).
- An accusatory demand to "STOP SPREADING LIES!" [T4-003068](#T4-003068).
- A #NoDAPL / #StandingRock appeal urging him to call off what the poster calls a "military atrocity," arguing the land belongs to the people by treaty with the US [T4-004648](#T4-004648).
- Praise for Channing Peters' bravery/courage, tagging Obama, Michelle Obama and Oprah with links [T4-002035](#T4-002035).
- A reply-chain post that simply accumulates many handles, including Obama and John Podesta, with a link and no substantive text [T4-009029](#T4-009029).
- A lighthearted post calling Obama, Dion Waiters... (i.e., @drose and @JoakimNoah) "the 3 homies" and "3 of Chicago's Finest" [T4-006365](#T4-006365).
- A political rebuke about terminology — "A terrorist is a terrorist is a terrorist. You should learn how to say it." — addressed to several officials including Obama [T4-009410](#T4-009410).

Overall, the mentions mix criticism (tax returns, "lies," Dakota Access Pipeline, terrorism language) with casual praise/fan content, and no post is a substantive policy statement by Obama himself.
